title: v2.media.init_video_upload
label: SHOPEE · API REFERENCE
html:
Use this API to initialize a new video upload task and obtain a unique upload session ID.

Request

Request Address

POST/api/v2/media/init_video_upload

Base URL: https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/media/init_video_upload

Common Request Parameters

NameTypeRequiredSampleDescription
partner_idintFalse1Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.
timestamptimestampFalse1610000000This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.
signstringFalsee318d3e932719916a9f9ebb57e2011961bd47abfa54a36e040d050d8931596e2Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: <a href= https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2> https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2</a>

Request Parameters

NameTypeRequiredSampleDescription
businessint32True3<p>Defines the business type of the uploaded image. Supported values: </p><p>3 = Video</p>
sceneint32True1<p>Defines the purpose of the uploaded image under the specified business type. Supported values: </p><p>- If business = 3 (Video): 1 = Shopee Video</p>
file_namestringTruetest_video_name.mp4<p>Original video file name.</p>
file_sizeint64True26214400<p>Total video file size in bytes. Rules and restrictions by business and scene: </p><p>- If business = 3 (Video) and scene = 1 (Shopee Video): Maximum <b>1GB</b>.</p>
durationint32True105<p>Video duration in seconds. Rules and restrictions by business and scene:</p><p>- If business = 3 (Video) and scene = 1 (Shopee Video): <b>1s~180s</b>.</p>

import requests
import json

url = "https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/media/init_video_upload?partner_id=partner_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp"

payload=json.dumps({
  "business": 3,
  "duration": 105,
  "file_name": "test_video_name.mp4",
  "file_size": 26214400,
  "scene": 1
})
headers = {
  'Content-Type': 'application/json'
}
response = requests.RPCRequest("POST",url,headers=headers, data=payload, allow_redirects=False)

print(response.text)
